podcast.body: This song was a hit for Kansas, reaching number 11, and is credited with saving the band from being dropped by Don Kirshner's record label. Songwriter Kerry Livgren, who later became a born-again Christian and Christian rock artist, stated in a 2004 interview that the song was autobiographical, representing his "own spiritual journey" and "a song of self-encouragement" in his search for truth. "Kansas got that hit with Carry on Wayward's Son in 1976, which made it to number 11, and probably saved the band."
